title: grpc_schema input
description: Input schema for the grpc_schema tool.

source.description: Input shape. Only 'descriptor_set' is currently supported; 'file' is rejected with a pointer to protoc --include_imports.

descriptor_set_b64.description: Base64-encoded FileDescriptorSet payload (max 16 MiB after base64 decode). Generate via `protoc --include_imports --descriptor_set_out=<file> <protos>`.

service_filter.description: Optional fully-qualified service names to register. Empty means register every service.

source_label.description: Free-form label preserved in list output (filename hint, version tag, etc.).

proto_paths.description: Reserved for a future Issue (source='file' deferred); the field is rejected when populated.
